$sources: AISC 341-22 Seismic Provisions for Structural Steel Buildings: Chapters A-K (systems E1-E4, F1-F5, composite members D1.4b, composite plate shear walls H6), with AISC 358 for the prequalified moment connections
source: AISC 341-22: expected strengths, width-thickness limits, moment frames (E1-E4: connections, panel zones, bracing), braced frames (F1-F4: SCBF, OCBF, EBF links, BRBF), special plate shear walls (F5), composite members and walls; the numbers 341-22 keeps from 341-05 are the default pack's, cited as AISC 341-22's

hss.label: Hollow structural sections, ASTM A500 Grade C

hssOther.label: Hollow structural sections, ASTM A500 Grade B, A501

expected.note: AISC 341-22 Sec A3.2 (Ry, Rt by ASTM specification). A steel no row names takes the table's largest Ry and Rt: SAEngine practice

web.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1, webs of I-shapes in flexure or combined flexure and compression: Ca <= 0.114: 2.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (1 - 1.04 Ca); above: 0.88 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (2.68 - Ca) >= 1.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy))

widthThickness.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 (highly ductile, λhd): coefficients of sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)), round HSS of E/(Ry Fy); Ca = Pu / (φc Py), φc 0.90. H-pile flanges and webs, flat bars and the relaxed ratio of SMF columns are the default pack's values

web.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1, webs of I-shapes: Ca <= 0.114: 3.96 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (1 - 3.04 Ca); above: 1.29 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)) (2.12 - Ca) >= 1.57 sqrt(E/(Ry Fy))

widthThicknessModerate.note: AISC 341-22 Table D1.1 (moderately ductile, λmd), coefficients of sqrt(E/(Ry Fy)); rectangular HSS walls 0.76 (SAEngine's reading, to verify); H-pile and flat bar values the default pack's

imf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E2: beams and columns moderately ductile (E2.5a); drift angle 0.02 rad (E2.6b); required shear by Mpr = Cpr Ry Fy Z (E2.6d, AISC 358 Sec 2.4.3); beams braced at Lb <= 0.19 ry E / (Ry Fy), braces 0.06 Ry Fy Z / ho (E2.4a, D1.2a)

smf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E3: beams and columns highly ductile (E3.5a); drift angle 0.04 rad, 0.80 Mp at the column face (E3.6b); required shear by Mpr = Cpr Ry Fy Z, Cpr = (Fy + Fu) / (2 Fy) <= 1.2 (E3.6d, AISC 358 Sec 2.4.3); panel zone φv 1.00 (E3.6e.1), t >= (dz + wz) / 90 (E3.6e.2); ΣM*pc / ΣM*pb > 1.0 (E3.4a, exempt below 0.3 Pc); beams braced at Lb <= 0.095 ry E / (Ry Fy), braces 0.06 Ry Fy Z / ho (E3.4b, D1.2b)

omf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E1: FR connections for 1.1 Ry Mp or the largest moment the system can deliver (E1.6b(a)), PR connections at least 0.5 Mp of the weaker member (E1.6b(c)), continuity plates (E1.6c); the default pack's numbers, the same

stmf.note: AISC 341-22 Sec E4 (special truss moment frames): the default pack's numbers (span <= 20 m, depth <= 1.8 m, the special segment 0.1-0.5 of the span, Vne = 3.75 Mnc / Ls + 0.075 E I Ls / L³ + ...), cited as E4; ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1 has no STMF row in the pack's systems, so no structural system selects it

sources.trigger: AISC 341-22 Sec A1; ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1: the provisions apply to steel systems with R above 3

plateWalls.note: AISC 341-22 Sec F5: web shear Vn = 0.42 Fy tw Lcf sin 2α, φ 0.90 (F5.5b); 0.8 < L/h <= 2.5; VBE Ic >= 0.0031 tw h⁴ / L (F5.4a); HBE bracing and the connections the default pack's numbers

compositeSeismic.note: AISC 341-22 Sec A3.5 (concrete of composite members: f'c 21-69 MPa normal weight, at most 41 MPa lightweight), Sec D1.4b (composite columns of ordinary, moderately and highly ductile systems), Chapters G and H (composite systems); the other numbers the default pack's (AISC 341-05 Part II based), cited as AISC 341-22's
